name: potential-guide
description: Objective guidance, regulation, and portfolio supervision packages.

scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run pack:check
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && node -e "for (const path of ['.cache', '.turbo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && biome lint scripts objectives
scripts.test: pnpm self-check:check && turbo run test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --pretty false
